manifest.name: @intent-navigator/dsh-plugin
manifest.description: Intent diagnosis, clarification, task briefing, and execution authorization for DeepSeek Harness

readme.text: Early implementation of a task-entry plugin for DeepSeek Harness. It adds task-brief tools, a navigation policy, pre-step state context, and a pre-execution authorization gate.

```sh
npm install
npm run typecheck
npm test
npm run build

Build and pack:

```sh
npm install
npm run build
npm pack
```

Then install the generated tarball into a DSH profile:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add /absolute/path/to/intent-navigator-dsh-plugin-0.1.0.tgz
```

Restart that profile after installation. Do not use this prototype as the only approval boundary for production, destructive, financial, credential, or publication operations.
